component.name: Envarsa
component.summary: A local library for your .env files

description.p: Envarsa keeps the environment values of all your projects in one library on your computer. Capture a project’s .env file as a snapshot, find a value again with everything masked, and hand it back by copying it or writing a .env.local file.

ul.li: Capture a .env file by picking it, dropping it on the window or pasting its lines
Values stay masked until you reveal one
Copied values are cleared from the clipboard after 30 seconds
Write a .env.local into a project, merged with what is already there, with a preview first
Every capture is kept as a snapshot, and older snapshots can be restored
See which keys and values are shared between projects
Optional passphrase encryption of the whole library
Export and import, to back up the library or move it to another computer

description.p: The library is a single file. There is no account, no cloud and no telemetry, and this build has no network access.
Note: uninstalling with “flatpak uninstall --delete-data” also deletes the library. Export a copy first.

screenshot.caption: An empty library, ready for the first capture
Capturing a snapshot from pasted lines
Settings, with the store file and passphrase protection

description.p: The write dialog keeps the target of each tab, the delete dialog no longer locks up when a delete fails, and editing a project saves its name and folder together.
